# Your own code

React components, field types, pages and handlers of your own, loaded as plugins.

- [Custom components](../reference/custom-components.md#components): Your own React components used by name in layouts, reading data under the user's access.
- [Custom list displays](../reference/custom-components.md#list-displays): Draw a list with your own component while the list page keeps loading, filters, search and paging.
- [Custom record sections](../reference/custom-components.md#record-sections): Your own component on a record page, beside its sections.
- [Custom record cards](../reference/custom-components.md#record-cards): Draw each card with your own component, with the built-in card as the fallback.
- [Custom field types](../reference/plugins.md#field-types): Register how a kind of value is shown and edited, and pick it per field in a view.
- [Custom create pages](../reference/custom-components.md#create-pages): Replace a resource's create form with your own page, such as a booking flow.
- [Form parts](../reference/custom-components.md#form-parts): Build your own forms from the app's fields, pickers, switches, buttons and dialogs.
- [Action handlers](../reference/custom-components.md#action-handlers): Your own code for a named action, with the record, the API client and the action's inputs.
- [Shell slots](../reference/custom-components.md#shell-slots): Your own components in the top bar, in a panel beside every page, or as the sidebar logo.
- [Plugins](../reference/plugins.md#how-a-plugin-stays-working): Your React code is a plugin that the app loads at start and that keeps working across Protobase releases without changes.
- [Plugin settings](../reference/plugins.md#loading): Plugins are loaded from the config, limited to roles and given settings.
- [Plugin fallbacks](../reference/plugins.md#when-a-plugin-is-off): A plugin that fails or does not fit the version is turned off alone, and admins see why.
- [Before sign-in](../reference/plugins.md#before-sign-in): A plugin can run around the sign-in page, for example to sign someone in from a link.
